language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, I'm Mariven. I live on the island of Barbados in the Antilles. The Antilles are a group of islands in the Caribbean. My family owns a dive shop on the beach. I help at the shop after school.
I like science, and especially biology. Besides, it's important to know how the human body works when you dive. I mean, diving has big effects on your body systems, like your muscles.
Dive in and learn about muscles and bones!
Hello, I am Tim.
Hi, I'm Mariven. I live on the island of Barbados in the Antilles. The Antilles are a group of islands in the Caribbean. My family owns a dive shop on the beach. I help at the shop after school.
I like science, and especially biology. Besides, it's important to know how the human body works when you dive. I mean, diving has big effects on your body systems, like your muscles.
Dive in and learn about muscles and bones!
I like to walk on the beach and find shells near my family's shop.

Did you know that these shells were once the outer layers of animals living in the sea, like mussels or crabs? These creatures do not have bones inside their bodies like us humans. It's almost like they are built inside out!
Even though you cannot easily see your own bones, it is important to know a little about them.
Do you think these statements are true or false?

activities.subtitle: Bones cannot grow in a cast to heal.

activities.subtitle: Bones continue to grow until you are 50 years old.

outro.text: Thank you for putting these facts together about bones!

After a dive, visitors to our dive shop sort the equipment into boxes.
Dive equipment supports our body by providing air. The suit also protects our body against the cold. It is the same with bones. They also serve two functions of support and protection.
Can you help sort the pictures and words about bones into the boxes?

I love to dive for clams and scallops in the sea. What's interesting is that they have a pair of shells that open and close with a muscle. Our muscles and bones work the same way. They pair up together to help us move.
Can you help me track down the bones and muscles that belong together?

One of our visitors has a cool custom dive suit with muscles painted on it. When he moves, I can see the muscles on the suit contract and relax. Just like the actual muscles underneath the skin.
That way I saw that muscles always work in pairs: one to make a bone move one way and the other to make it move the other way.
For each diving activity, could you match the muscles being used in that action?

helperSimple.text: Mariven describes an activity. Click on the pictures showing the muscles that you use to do that activity. Then, click on "Check" to see if you are right!
